utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Ira — what’s the priority for the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: The priority is getting the broken essentials fixed first — leaks, wiring, and anything unsafe. If you can help, I’d love a hand sorting the requests and spotting the most urgent ones.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll sort the requests and flag the unsafe ones first. Do you want me to start with leaks or wiring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand and bring over whatever tools you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — that’d really help. I’m a bit all over the place, but I’ll let you know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush at all — just send me the list when you’ve got it, and I’ll round up the tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s coming along nicely — I heard they’ve already got a few volunteers lined up. If you want, I can keep you posted on the next update.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be helpful, thanks. I’m just trying to figure out the timing and whether they still need anything practical brought over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I can check on that for you — last I heard, they were still sorting the schedule and could use a few donated tools and sturdy boxes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you help me keep track of the donation drop-off and the repair supply pickup locations?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can keep track of both the donation drop-off and the repair supply pickup locations.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m hearing about it too — if you’re going, I can spread the word and maybe bring a few neighbors along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’m still thinking it through, but I’d appreciate that if I do go.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — just give me a nod if you decide to go, and I’ll start rallying folks.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and warm thanks to you. What should we prioritize first on the block?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Start with the most urgent safety fixes, then the high-traffic spots on the block.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes sense — I’ll start with the urgent safety fixes, then map out the high-traffic spots. If you know any trouble areas, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the repair drive details? I want to make sure I’ve got everything right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I usually join a bit late, but I can recap the repair drive details for you. What part do you want to double-check?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — could you confirm the date, time, and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time works best for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s really helpful, Faye — I’m thinking Saturday morning works best, since folks are usually free then. Does 10 a.m. fit around the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, 10 a.m. works for me—I can make that fit around the school schedule. I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve mostly just heard bits and pieces—how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s going pretty well so far—people have been pitching in and we’re starting to see some real progress. I can fill you in on the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’d be great—what’s been getting fixed first?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the key details for the repair drive and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Could you confirm exactly what details you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just the date, what needs fixing, where to drop stuff off, and any costs or volunteer times.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Rey. I think the first thing is sorting the donated tools and seeing what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can start sorting the tools and make a missing list. If you want, I’ll also check what we already have on hand.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supply list and make sure we’re stocked for it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep telling neighbors and remind them about the date.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was meaning to check in about that. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still sorting a few details, but I’ll check what’s left and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — appreciate it. Just let me know what’s left, and I can help if needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly just sorting the donated tools and labeling the boxes. If you can help for an hour, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I can do an hour. Just point me to the tools and labels.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a few tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a clear list and swing by when it’s time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — just bring the list by and we’ll get you set up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Amazing — could you help rally a few neighbors and bring a simple sign-up list? I’ll spread the word fast and coordinate the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll rally a few neighbors and bring a simple sign-up list. I’ll keep it simple and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs fixing, and who should I connect with?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — the porch rail at the community hall still needs fixing, and you should connect with Mara on that one.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll reach out to Mara about the porch rail and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo — I’m getting the repair drive organized now. If you’ve got a spot we should prioritize, let me know and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — please prioritize the loose front steps by my porch; they’ve been getting worse.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ll put the loose front steps by your porch at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re still collecting repair requests and sorting the priority jobs. Do you want the quick version or the details?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Just the quick version, please—I’m still catching up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help make a simple sign-up list and spread the word to a few neighbors? I’m trying to line up times that don’t conflict with school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can do that — I’ll make a simple sign-up list and mention it to a few neighbors. I’ll avoid school pickup times when I share it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, I’m just checking — is the repair drive still happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, it’s still on this weekend. I’m happy to help if you need anything.
